items.en: Russia strikes Kyiv with Iskander-M, S-400 and Zircon missiles and jet drones hours after Abu Dhabi peace talks end
items.nl: Rusland valt Kyiv aan met Iskander-M-, S-400- en Zircon-raketten en straalaangedreven drones, uren na afloop van vredesoverleg in Abu Dhabi
items.sEn: Hours after the second day of US-brokered peace talks in Abu Dhabi ended without a meaningful breakthrough, Russia attacked Kyiv and the surrounding region overnight on 12 November, the Kyiv Independent reports. Explosions started around 01:00, minutes after Ukraine's Air Force warned of incoming ballistic missiles. A…

items.sEn: According to figures from Ukraine's General Staff published by ArmyInform, Russia launched 3,519 strike drones of the Shahed, Gerbera and Parodiya types at Ukraine between 1 and 10 November 2026, of which Ukrainian forces neutralised 3,068 (about 87%). items.en: Russia's 6–7 November combined strike on Kyiv used 36 ballistic missiles, including North Korean KN-23s, plus 172 drones; Zelensky says only four missiles were downed amid a Patriot interceptor shortage
items.nl: Russische gecombineerde aanval op Kyiv van 6 op 7 november met 36 ballistische raketten, waaronder Noord-Koreaanse KN-23's, en 172 drones; volgens Zelensky slechts vier raketten neergehaald door tekort aan Patriot-interceptors
items.sEn: On the night of 6–7 November Russia launched a combined strike on Ukraine with 172 drones (Shahed, Gerbera, Parodiya and other types) and missiles of the Iskander-M, Zircon, KN-23 and S-400 types, with Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast as the main target, according to the Ukrainian Air Force figures reported by Ukrainska Pravda. items.en: Ukrainian military intelligence says Russia can produce over 200 missiles a month, up to 110 of them ballistic, as Ukraine intercepted only about 7% of ballistic missiles in October
items.nl: Oekraïense militaire inlichtingendienst: Rusland kan ruim 200 raketten per maand produceren, waarvan tot 110 ballistisch, terwijl Oekraïne in oktober slechts circa 7% van de ballistische raketten onderschepte
items.sEn: Ukraine's military intelligence agency (HUR) said on its Telegram channel on 4 November that Russian industry can produce more than 200 ballistic and cruise missiles per month, up to 110 of them ballistic, and keeps increasing output despite sanctions. As of October, HUR estimates Russia holds up to 700 ballistic miss…

items.en: Russia's mass missile and drone strike of 2-3 November hits Ukrainian power plants and hospitals in Dnipro and Kharkiv; 38 killed nationwide in a day
items.nl: Russische massale raket- en droneaanval van 2-3 november treft Oekraïense centrales en ziekenhuizen in Dnipro en Charkiv; 38 doden landelijk in één dag
items.sEn: On the night of 2-3 November Russia launched one of its largest combined strikes of the war on Ukraine's energy system. items.en: Ukraine confirms missile strike on Energiya plant in Yelets, sole Russian maker of glide-bomb guidance batteries and supplier for Iskander and Kinzhal

items.sEn: On the afternoon of 25 October, missiles struck the Energiya plant in Yelets, Lipetsk Oblast, about 250 km from the Ukrainian border. items.en: HUR: Russia keeps missile stocks steady at up to 700 ballistic and several thousand cruise missiles, produces 200+ missiles a month, and has ordered over 100,000 Geran-type drones and decoys for 2026
